projects.title: Projects
projects.p1_desc: PowerApps + SharePoint app that allows each employee to access only the protocols assigned to their role and department.
projects.p1_why: I learned to integrate different tools into a coherent flow that automates tasks and reduces manual errors—my first step towards a “complete solution”.
projects.p1_problem: Employees couldn’t quickly find the right protocols for their role and department.
projects.p1_solution: PowerApps + SharePoint with role-based filtering and version-aware flow.
projects.p1_result: Evidence: repo and screenshots; built in a real internship context.
projects.p2_desc: Fictional product catalog with full CRUD: add, update, delete, filter and sort products across multiple screens.
projects.p2_why: It helped me structure data in a desktop app and keep consistency across screens—solid foundations for bigger projects.
projects.p2_problem: Need to manage a catalog with full operations and clear navigation.
projects.p2_solution: Desktop app with CRUD + filtering/sorting across consistent screens.
projects.p2_result: Evidence: repo with complete features (CRUD + filters + sorting).
projects.p3_desc: Agenda app to manage contacts and/or events with a clean, productivity-focused UI.
projects.p3_why: It helped me practice app structure, data persistence and a clean UI designed for real usage.
projects.p3_problem: Manage contacts/events in a simple way without relying on external tools.
projects.p3_solution: App with modular structure and persistence for day-to-day usage.
projects.p3_result: Evidence: repo with functional screens and complete management flow.
projects.p4_desc: Real-time collaborative bingo: multiple users join a room and the board state syncs instantly.
projects.p4_why: Previously called “BingoEnvidiosos”. Great practice for real-time sync, shared state and multi-user UX.
projects.p4_problem: In group bingo, boards get out of sync if each user tracks state independently.
projects.p4_solution: Shared rooms with real-time board state synchronization.
projects.p4_result: Evidence: repo with multi-user logic and synced state (no public demo).
projects.p5_desc: Automated E2E tests to validate real user flows on web, making sure key features don’t break.
projects.p5_why: It builds discipline: reproducible tests, early bug detection and a quality-first mindset.
projects.p5_problem: Website changes can silently break key flows until it’s too late.
projects.p5_solution: Selenium E2E suite that validates real user scenarios.
projects.p5_result: Evidence: repo with repeatable automated tests (CI-ready).
projects.p6_desc: A set of Kotlin mini-projects to master key areas: multimedia, concurrency and persistence.
projects.p6_why: Mini-case format: a real problem, a concrete solution and a clear competency signal.
projects.p6_problem: I wanted to master Kotlin through real, focused problems instead of only theory.
projects.p6_solution: A collection of mini-projects (coroutines, multimedia, persistence), one goal per case.
projects.p6_result: Evidence: 3 separate repos + mini-cases documented with problem/solution.
